title: START AT follows the direction of ORDER BY: with DESC the rows from the value downwards are returned
query: EVALUATE VALUES ( Product[Price] ) ORDER BY Product[Price] DESC START AT 50

source.quote: defines the rows to skip before the specified values according to the sort order specified in the ORDER BY section of EVALUATE
source.supports: the rows skipped are the ones before the value in the sort order of the query

derivation: Sorted descending: 100, 50, 20, 10. The row before 50 in that order is 100, which is skipped: 50, 20, 10 remain.
alternative: No page shows START AT with DESC. If START AT keeps the rows whose value is at least the given one whatever the direction, the result is 100, 50.
